base_rim_supports.method: Slim trees with a shared dense interface and a continuous nonplanar first perimeter
base_rim_supports.scope: A shared dense interface on the rim trees, with bridge paths across both stages of each insert recess.
base_rim_supports.selection_quote: Those arc fins snapped off super easy, and they provided excellent support.
base_rim_supports.tree_support_scope: The base uses Slim trees and a dense interface. Local blockers keep both stages of each insert recess clear.

edge_support_strategy.application: The base uses bridges across the insert recesses. The tip uses a hidden-root disc for bed anchorage and a separate dense interface at the inboard dispense face.
edge_support_strategy.method: Use dense tree interfaces and contoured first perimeters on the base rim and tip mating lip.
edge_support_strategy.selection_quote: I'm quite convinced that we need to do this everywhere, that we've got these rough edges on overhangs.

selected_finish.first_layer_selection_quote: I don't know why bambu defaults 0.24 layer height to a 0.20 first layer, but if I don't have a reason to muck with a bambu default choice, I don't muck with it. I haven't had a reason to muck with it ...
selected_finish.layer_selection_quote: I'd like to go back to the same layer height everywhere as our final production print settings.

overhang_recipe.scope: Part cooling is off on ordinary paths. Force 70% only on bridges and wall paths with at least 50% of their bead width unsupported, after the first three bed layers. No layer-time cooling, auxiliary part cooling or fan pre-start.
overhang_recipe.selection_quote: the cooling, high cooling, is totally fine. We can use 100% cooling if we want, but only on the places that actually need it, and everywhere else we shouldn't be using that cooling.

rear_seam_enforcement.target: Complete outer rear silhouette at each build Z, including tilted stage shoulders; facets crossing CAD X=0 +/-0.25 mm

selected_finish.scope: Complete Industrial faucet with the Sculpted display cover. Uniform model layers, selected seams and localized cooling. The base rim, tip mating lip and inboard dispense face use local nonplanar paths.
selected_finish.selection_basis: Derek approves the Industrial faucet with the corrected lowered tip and extended Sculpted cover; production retains Bambu's 0.20 mm first bed layer and uses 0.24 mm later layers without fine bands.

tip_rear_seam_enforcement.target: Outer curved neck rear meridian at CAD X=0, excluding plug and display-frame surfaces

tip_supports.method: Dense Slim trees at the mating lip, a contoured first perimeter and a hidden-root disc
tip_supports.root_contact_scope: Hidden male insertion terminal end only. The directly bonded disc leaves a scuff; do not transfer this bonded contact to visible surfaces.
tip_supports.selection_quote: That worked. That disc works in this case, and is removable, but it leaves a bit of a scuff that would be a problem on a visible surface, but since its on the male insertion portion that is hidden, we are golden here.
tip_supports.tree_support_scope: The mating lip has a scoped dense roof and the inboard dispense face has a separate outlet keepout.

selected_finish.wall_generators: Retain base Arachne for the continuous reinforced foot; other rigid parts retain Classic.

selected_finish_scope: Complete Industrial faucet with the Sculpted display cover. Uniform model layers, selected seams and localized cooling. The base rim, tip mating lip and inboard dispense face use local nonplanar paths.
